title: Executive-as-a-Service (EaaS)
subtitle: Capital is a commodity. Senior executive leadership capable of navigating regulatory complexity, security architecture, and organisational scaling is scarce — and that scarcity is precisely what Attolloo provides.

sections.heading: The Competence Investment Thesis:
sections.body:
Attolloo contributes senior executive capacity — CEO governance, CSO risk architecture, HR Director leadership — in exchange for equity or performance-based revenue shares. No dilutive capital is deployed. The investment is time, expertise, and methodology. The return is equity at exit.

This model works because experienced executive leadership with regulatory depth is genuinely scarce at the early stage — and its absence is the primary reason high-potential ventures in regulated sectors stall or fail.

> The EaaS model is not consulting. A consultant delivers a report and leaves. I take equity — which means my success is directly coupled to the portfolio company's success. That alignment is the foundational difference.

sections.heading: Three Engagement Roles
sections.body:
BOARD MEMBER — Strategic direction, investor relations, governance structure, and structured decision frameworks that account for risk and uncertainty explicitly. Board-level accountability with full 4-pillar methodology deployed.

STRATEGIC ADVISER — Framework deployment across the full 4-pillar stack: 6Sense qualification, Polaris sprint design, AI Compass diagnostic, Kando operational intelligence. Structured advisory with deliverable accountability.

OPERATIVE PARTNER — Hands-on interim leadership — CEO, CSO, or HR Director — during critical transition periods: funding rounds, regulatory audits, market entry, or leadership gaps. Full executive accountability.

sections.heading: Who This Is For
sections.body:
Attolloo works with early-stage AI companies operating in sectors where regulatory complexity creates both risk and competitive moat:

- Fintech and Regtech — EU AI Act, DORA, MiFID II, and GDPR compliance as commercial prerequisites
- Legal technology — AI-assisted legal analysis under sector-specific regulation
- Health data and clinical AI — GDPR, MDR, and AI Act high-risk classification
- Cybersecurity-as-a-service — NIS2, DORA, and sector-specific security frameworks
- HR technology — AI-driven hiring and workforce management under EU AI Act Annex III
- Compliance automation — regulatory monitoring and governance documentation

Exclusions: consumer-facing products, hardware without a software governance layer, life science outside competence scope, and pre-revenue ventures without documented evidence that the product solves a real problem for paying customers.

If your company fits this profile and needs C-level governance depth — not just capital — reach out directly.
